recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast night scene featuring two figures in voluminous, textured fur parkas positioned in front of two iconic, twisting brutalist skyscrapers. The scene is set during a heavy snowstorm, with falling flakes captured as white streaks against a pitch-black sky. The buildings are illuminated by glowing red rings at their summits, providing a stark color contrast to the monochromatic snow and dark architecture.
coreVisualRelationships: Organic, bulky texture of fur versus the rigid, repetitive horizontal ribbing of the skyscrapers
Bright white foreground snow balancing the deep black void of the night sky
Glowing red accents at the top of the towers acting as a chromatic anchor for the entire composition
Diagonal movement of falling snow contrasting with the vertical, twisting ascent of the buildings
coreInvariants: Twisting, hourglass-shaped skyscrapers with horizontal ribbing
Heavy snowfall captured with high-speed flash or short exposure
Figures obscured by oversized, hooded fur garments
Deep black background with minimal light pollution

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures are centered in the lower-middle ground, appearing small relative to the massive towers but large relative to the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing red circular tops of the two skyscrapers.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright snow in the foreground, moves up through the textured figures, follows the twisting lines of the towers, and rests on the red lights at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The vast, dark sky occupying the upper third and sides of the frame creates a sense of isolation and scale.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark charcoal (sky and building shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red (neon rings at the tower peaks)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between the bright highlights of the snow/fur and the dark sky, with low saturation except for the intense red accents.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle night shot of two twisting, hourglass-shaped skyscrapers with horizontal ribbed facades. The tops of the buildings should have glowing red circular lights. The foreground should be a mound of textured white snow. The sky is pitch black with heavy falling snow captured as white streaks. Two figures in oversized, thick fur coats (one white, one grey) are huddled in the center foreground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a minimalist, wide-tracked sans-serif font in white or red, positioned in the upper negative space of the sky to maintain the sense of scale.

verificationChecks: Ensure the towers have the distinct twisting, ribbed brutalist texture.
Check that the red lights at the top are the only source of saturated color.
Verify the snow texture appears both as a solid ground and as falling particles.
Confirm the figures are sufficiently obscured by the fur hoods.

adjustableVariables: Color of the neon rings (e.g., blue or green instead of red)
Proximity of the figures to the camera
Texture of the fur (long vs. short pile)
mustRedesign: Avoid any specific brand logos on the clothing
Ensure the architecture is stylized and not a direct copy of specific protected landmarks

mustAchieve: Tactile texture in the fur and snow
avoid: Low-resolution grain in the dark areas
Cartoonish or overly saturated colors outside the red accents

postGenerationChecks: Are the red lights at the top of the towers glowing clearly?
Is the snow in the foreground bright enough to provide a base for the composition?
Do the buildings maintain their twisting, ribbed silhouette against the black sky?
Is the falling snow visible as distinct white streaks or dots?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Brutalist Architecture] with [Extreme Weather] and [High-Fashion Textures] using a [Triadic Value Scale: Black, White, and one Neon Accent].
